meta.title: Salon — Booking & Management
meta.description: Book appointments and manage your salon across branches.

home.kicker: We take care of the bookings, so you can take care of your customers.
home.title: Run your salon. Fill every chair.
home.subtitle: Online booking, staff scheduling, and appointment management — built for salons across the Kingdom, in Arabic and English.

booking.title: Online booking
booking.body: A booking page for each salon — customers pick a service, staff, and time.

branches.title: Multi-branch
branches.body: One account, many branches. Services, staff, and hours per location.

reminders.title: SMS reminders
reminders.body: Confirmations and reminders by SMS to cut no-shows.

book.noSlots: No times available on this day — try another date.

book.pastDay: Today's hours have ended — please pick another date.

book.wrongCode: That code is wrong or expired.

book.doneSub: A confirmation has been sent to your phone.

book.cancelledSub: Hope to see you another time.

paywall.title: Your free trial has ended
paywall.body: Subscribe to keep taking bookings and managing your salon.

customers.title: Customers
customers.empty: No customers yet. They're added automatically when you take a booking.
customers.name: Name
customers.importIntro: Paste your customers below — one per line, as: Name, phone (email and notes are optional). Or upload a CSV.
customers.importHint: Numbers can be local (0501234567) or international. Existing customers are matched by phone and updated — never duplicated.

settings.title: Salon settings
settings.name: Salon name
settings.brandColorHint: Used on your public booking page & “Book Now” button — not the console.
settings.socialHint: Shown on your public booking page. Paste your profile link, or just the @handle.
settings.logoHint: Shown on your public booking page — PNG, JPG or SVG, up to 2 MB.
settings.bookingPageHint: Share this link or print the QR code so customers can book online.
settings.notifChannelHint: How booking confirmations and reminders are sent. Verification codes always go by SMS.

offers.title: Offers & packages
offers.intro: Promo banners shown at the top of your booking page. Add a deal, package, or seasonal offer.
offers.empty: No offers yet. Add a banner to promote a deal on your booking page.
offers.chooseBanner: Upload a banner (wide image works best)
offers.caption: Caption (optional)
offers.captionPlaceholder: e.g. Eid package — 3 services for 199 SAR
offers.linkHint: Where tapping the banner goes — e.g. your WhatsApp or a details page.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your salon dashboard
login.connError: Can't reach the server. Is the API running on port 8000?
login.tagline: Run your salon. Fill every chair.
login.eyebrow: You run the salon — we handle the rest

common.confirmDelete: Delete this? This can't be undone.

branches.title: Branches
branches.name: Branch name
branches.mapsUrlHint: Paste a Google Maps link to your salon — customers tap it for directions.
branches.empty: No branches yet. Add your first location.
branches.noStaff: No staff yet — invite your team first.

services.title: Services
services.name: Service name
services.empty: No services yet. Add what your salon offers.
services.noStaffYet: No staff yet — invite your team first.
services.branchHint: A staff member becomes bookable once they also work at a branch (Branches → Assign staff).

services.nameRequired: Enter a name in Arabic or English.
services.noneInCategory: No services in this category yet.
services.importIntro: Upload a photo of your price list — we'll read the services so you can review and add them.
services.importBilingual: Arabic, English, or both — you can add more than one photo and we'll match them up.
services.importFound: Found {n} services. Edit anything, remove what you don't want, then add them.
services.importEmpty: We couldn't find any services on that image — try a clearer photo.
services.importAssignHint: Applies to all imported services — adjust any service individually later.
services.importNoStaff: No team members yet — you can add services now and assign staff later from the Team page.

billing.title: Subscription
billing.confirmCancel: Cancel your subscription? It stays active until the period ends.

onboarding.staffBody: Invite the staff who'll take appointments.
onboarding.branchBody: Set your location, address for directions, and working hours.
